title: Bar Drop Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Pineapple Ice by Drop offers a burst of tropical sunshine with a cool finish. It captures the authentic, tangy-sweet taste of fresh pineapple, delivering a punchy fruit inhale. A layer of crushed ice on the exhale refreshes the palate, making it an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy a vibrant, cooling fruit profile. Distinct from typical bar salts, this e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio. This composition prioritises flavour clarity, ensuring the sharp pineapple notes are vivid and distinct. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kits, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth draw and quick satisfaction, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
